Edge two is built so it works when a caller does exist; the reachability defect belongs to V2-091. (d) internal/runner/orchestrator.go still carries an Increment through Plan, Prepare, Claim and Start; after edge two lands it will also carry its parent, but only when the parent is in ready, and RunFakeJourney never frames its Requirement, so its parent stays captured and its journey test is untouched.
